cards.card_text: So his sons can be ordained in them So the people will remember Aaron So they can be stored in the tent
cards.verse_text: The holy garments that belong to Aaron will belong to his sons after him, so they can be anointed and ordained in them.
cards.snippet: …belong to his sons after him, so they can be anointed and ordained in them.

cards.card_text: God tells Moses to take seven days to ordain Aaron and his sons, with a bull sacrificed as a sin offering each day for atonement.
cards.verse_text: This is what you are to do for Aaron and his sons based on all that I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.
cards.snippet: …based on all that I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.

cards.card_text: Afterward, Moses tells the Levites they've been ordained for service to the LORD today.
cards.verse_text: Afterward, Moses said, “Today you have been ordained for service to the LORD, since each man went against his son and his brother; so the LORD has bestowed a blessing on you this day.”
cards.snippet: Afterward, Moses said, “Today you have been ordained for service to the LORD, since each man went against his son…

cards.card_text: The priest ordained to succeed his father Whoever the elders of Israel choose The oldest man from each tribe
cards.verse_text: The priest who is anointed and ordained to succeed his father as high priest shall make atonement.
cards.snippet: The priest who is anointed and ordained to succeed his father as high priest shall make atonement.

cards.card_text: Aaron's four sons are anointed and ordained to serve as ___.
cards.verse_text: These were Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.
cards.snippet: These were Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.

cards.card_text: Once more Balaam lifts up an oracle: “Ah, who can live unless God has ordained it?”
cards.verse_text: Once more Balaam lifted up an oracle, saying: “Ah, who can live unless God has ordained it?
cards.snippet: …lifted up an oracle, saying: “Ah, who can live unless God has ordained it?

cards.card_text: So there he is in Bethel, offering sacrifices and burning incense at a feast he ordained for the Israelites, in a month he picked all by himself.

cards.card_text: Josiah also does away with the priests the kings of Judah had ordained for the high places.
cards.verse_text: Josiah also did away with the idolatrous priests ordained by the kings of Judah to burn incense on the high places of the cities of Judah and in the places all around Jerusalem—those who had burned incense to Baal, to the sun and moon, to the constellations, and to all the host of heaven.
cards.snippet: Josiah also did away with the idolatrous priests ordained by the kings of Judah to burn incense on the high places…

cards.card_text: Next the song says to remember His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations.
cards.verse_text: Remember His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations— the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
cards.snippet: Remember His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations— the covenant He made with Abraham, and the…

cards.card_text: Solomon tells Hiram that this way of worshiping the LORD is ordained for Israel forever.
cards.verse_text: This is ordained for Israel forever.
cards.snippet: This is ordained for Israel forever.

cards.card_text: Ordain judgment Proclaim peace Grant rest
cards.verse_text: Awake, my God, and ordain judgment.
cards.snippet: Awake, my God, and ordain judgment.

cards.card_text: Then David talks about praise that God Himself has ordained.
cards.verse_text: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.
cards.snippet: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.

cards.card_text: The LORD has ordained His covenant forever.
cards.verse_text: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
cards.snippet: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.

cards.card_text: Then he turns and talks straight to God: 'You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.' Then he takes a good look at his own life.
cards.verse_text: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.
cards.snippet: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.

cards.card_text: His hands stretched out the heavens, and He ordained all their host.
cards.verse_text: It was My hands that stretched out the heavens, and I ordained all their host.
cards.snippet: It was My hands that stretched out the heavens, and I ordained all their host.

cards.card_text: The poem says the decree the LORD accomplished was one He ordained in days of old.
cards.verse_text: The LORD has done what He planned; He has accomplished His decree, which He ordained in days of old; He has overthrown you without pity.
cards.snippet: …has done what He planned; He has accomplished His decree, which He ordained in days of old; He has overthrown you without pity.

cards.card_text: The writer asks who has spoken and it came to pass, unless someone has ordained it.
cards.verse_text: Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has ordained it?
cards.snippet: Who has spoken and it came to pass, unless the Lord has ordained it?

cards.verse_text: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for I had ordained you.
cards.snippet: You were anointed as a guardian cherub, for I had ordained you.
